scope: price-layer causal measurement and first-shock incremental-risk experiment; no trading
primary_event: absolute close-to-close return >30 bp AND >4 times prior-30-minute RMS
fast_proxy: mean trailing energies of Haar lengths 2 and 4
working_proxy: mean trailing energies of Haar lengths 8 and 16
residual_model: standardized ridge alpha=1 on training only; HF log-energy conditional on all baseline features
predictor: standardized logistic C=1, no class weights, max_iter=2000; baseline versus baseline+residual
threshold_fit: quantiles of 2023 scores; frozen; report actual evaluation coverage
matched_coverage: evaluation-only ranking diagnostic, not a deployable threshold; stable timestamp tie-break
inference: paired five-trading-day moving-block bootstrap, 500 replicates, seed 20260907; year and index split; no promotion from synthetic
unknown_policy: do not fill missing/repair prices; require known quiet interval and known future labels for metrics; retain Unknown coverage
first_event_policy: 30 previous known event-free minutes within same half-session; never called exogenous
event_matching: unique event; alarm at t usable only if 2 <= event_close_index-t <= 15; event-onset lower bound event_close-1 minute
dense_window_metric: future (t,t+15] first-event target includes imminent event; not equivalent to minimum-lead event recall
snapshot_helper_only: 15-second as-of grid, max observation age 3 seconds, reject a crossed source gap >3 seconds; same-second greatest row_index explicit; no interpolation
